text.tspan: Property taxes and development charges by municipality
*Average residential values, sourced from CMHC’s Market Absorption Survey from Q3 2024 to Q2 2025. Ontario assessed
values are scaled down to 2016 benchmarks using the Teranet Home Price Index.
Tax rates and development charges come from municipal websites. They are written as mill rates, which means they should
be divided by 1,000 to get the percentage of the property value charged in tax. Development charges per square foot come
from the CHBA’s Municipal Benchmarking 2024 Study. Development charges for Brossard come from a CMHC Housing
